source.section: MI-1040 line 9a (PDF page 10, Line 9a: number of exemptions x 5,800); MI-1040 lines 9a, 10, 13-17 (PDF page 10 Line 9a, Line 10, Line 17; PDF page 11 example: line 14 income subject to tax less line 15 exemptions = line 16 taxable income); record cite PDF page 10 Line 9a and Line 9e, PDF page 3

worked: Federal AGI = wages 50,000.00 = 50,000.00. Federal taxable income = 50,000.00 - federal standard deduction (15,750.00) = 34,250.00; given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Michigan: line 10 AGI 50,000.00; no additions or subtractions; line 14 50,000.00; line 9a one exemption (no dependents, nobody else can claim the filer) 1 x 5,800 = 5,800.00, carried to line 15; line 16 = 50,000.00 - 5,800.00 = 44,200.00. MI-1040 line 17 tax = 44,200.00 x 0.0425 = 1,878.50. No credits; state income tax 1,878.50.
